title: A must see experience
text: Such beautiful views, well worth the trip. Take a jacket, it was cold. Our guide was so informative, we had a great day

title: A Barcelona must do trip
text: Marcel was the perfect host and guide, he shared his knowledge and was able to answer all our questions. The views were spectacular, and one of the best sceneries we have seen.
